adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }` and the caught `err` is not logged or rethrown. This makes failures in the post-persist side effect (sending emails) hard to debug/observe in production, even though the primary operation (persisting guests) has already succeeded. This is a concrete, diff-grounded maintainability/operability issue rather than a direct functional correctness bug.
